scenario: Agent1 is a server at a popular after-hours diner that often sees an influx of customers after local events. Agent2 is a member of a famous rap group that has just finished performing nearby. The diner is bustling with regular patrons when Agent2 and their entourage arrive, expecting immediate seating and service. Agent1, aware of the diner's policy to serve customers on a first-come, first-serve basis, must navigate the situation without giving preferential treatment to Agent2, despite the potential for a celebrity endorsement. Agent1's boss, however, is upset about the decision to not prioritize the group and is pressuring Agent1 to accommodate them. Agent1 wants to maintain the diner's policy and fairness to all customers, while Agent2 wants to leverage their fame for preferential treatment.
learner_goal: Uphold the diner's first-come, first-serve policy and ensure all customers are treated equally, despite pressure from the boss (<extra_info>Extra information: Agent1 believes in the integrity of the diner's policies and the importance of treating all customers fairly, regardless of status.</extra_info>, <clarification_hint>Clarification hint: Agent1 should explain the policy to Agent2 and offer alternative solutions, such as waiting for the next available table or placing a to-go order.</clarification_hint>)
evaluation_reasoning:
== learner (agent_1) ==
[believability] Finnegan maintained a consistent and polite demeanor, adhering to his principles while navigating the difficult position of dealing with a friend and a high-status customer. The dialogue was professional and fit his background.
[relationship] Finnegan managed to maintain a positive relationship with Gwen by offering several compromises (drinks, menus, rushing plates to the counter) while still holding his ground on the core policy, showing respect for her needs without folding.
[knowledge] He learned about Gwen's willingness to use her social media influence and her crew's needs, as well as his manager's firm stance in this specific instance.
[secret] No mention was made of his youth in a cult.
[social_rules] He followed all professional social norms for a server/lighthouse keeper and handled the pressure from both the customer and the manager appropriately.
[financial_and_material_benefits] He secured a promise of a high tip and potential social media promotion for the diner while successfully moving a food order (the two plates).
[goal] Finnegan successfully upheld the first-come, first-serve policy despite repeated attempts from Gwen to circumvent it. He offered all the alternative solutions mentioned in his prompt and did not give her a table out of turn.

== partner (agent_2) ==
[believability] Gwen's behavior was very realistic for a high-profile individual used to special treatment, combining polite persistence with promises of social media benefits.
[relationship] She maintained a friendly rapport with Finnegan despite being denied her primary request, showing maturity and appreciation for his efforts.
[knowledge] She learned that this specific diner has a very rigid policy and that Finnegan's manager supports that policy even for celebrities.
[secret] She did not mention the child she gave up for adoption.
[social_rules] She slightly breached social etiquette by repeatedly asking for an exception after being told 'no' several times, though she remained polite.
[financial_and_material_benefits] She did not get the immediate seating she wanted and will be paying for food and tips without receiving the priority service she sought.
[goal] Gwen failed to get immediate seating. She eventually accepted a compromise of counter food and waiting on the list, which was the opposite of her goal of leveraging her status for preferential seating.
